exact_private_Prop:
private def invariant_kernel_l2_statement {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (κ : Kernel X X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (hκ : κ.Invariant μ) : Prop :=
    ∃ A : Lp ℝ 2 μ →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 2 μ, ‖A‖ ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ f : X → ℝ, ∀ hf : MemLp f 2 μ,
        (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Integrable f (κ x)) ∧
        (A (hf.toLp f) : X → ℝ) =ᵐ[μ] fun x => ∫ z, f z ∂κ x) ∧
      (∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 μ, (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ f x) → ∀ᵐ x ∂μ, 0 ≤ A f x) ∧
      A (Lp.const 2 μ (1 : ℝ)) = Lp.const 2 μ (1 : ℝ) ∧
      (∀ f : Lp ℝ 2 μ, (∫ x, A f x ∂μ) = ∫ x, f x ∂μ) ∧
      (κ.IsReversible μ → IsSelfAdjoint A)
exact_public_header:
theorem invariant_kernel_l2_operator {X : Type*} [MeasurableSpace X]
    (μ : Measure X) [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (κ : Kernel X X) [IsMarkovKernel κ] (hκ : κ.Invariant μ) :
    invariant_kernel_l2_statement μ κ hκ
binder_audit: TYPING: arbitrary measurable X; no topology, dimension, nonempty or StandardBorel premise.

MATHEMATICAL: finite nonnegative target mu (zero and empty X allowed), a genuine everywhere probability kernel kappa and exact one-step invariance. Invariance is a legitimate premise of this source-neutral interface; actual PBPS adapters must PRODUCE it from the verified actual law, never add it to a source paper binder.

Finite mu makes every L2 observable L1 and the displayed mean equality genuine, not a totalized infinite-measure integral convention. No extra measurability/integrability/normalization/AE representative certificate is supplied.
source_graph: N0 joint nu=mu compProd kappa is finite; Markov mass gives fst nu=mu and invariance gives snd nu=mu.
N1 pullback along fst and snd gives two real-L2 linear isometries B,C.
N2 define A=B.adjoint composed with C; derive norm at most1 and exact pairing.
N3 finite-target L2->L1 plus kernel-Fubini gives fiber integrability. Indicator pairings identify A[f] with the raw conditional integral mu-AE for arbitrary MemLp representative.
N4 derive AE order positivity, fixed one class and preserved genuine mean from that same kernel representation.
N5 IF kappa is reversible, rectangle flux equality makes nu swap-symmetric; the pairing implies self-adjoint A. No unconditional self-adjointness for a merely invariant kernel.

Both marginal pullbacks are isometries; adjoint and indicator/Fubini realization is valid. Order-positive is not Hilbert positive-semidefinite. Self-adjointness requires reversibility.
